verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. Temporal documents strategies for tuning Workers and Task Queue processing to manage resources (temporal-docs-29, temporal-docs-49), which implies some control over concurrency. Temporal Cloud also enforces rate limits (temporal-docs-45), but those are platform-imposed service limits, not user-configured fairness controls. Missing for 10: explicit per-workflow concurrency caps, per-key or per-tenant rate limiting, fairness or priority mechanisms that stop one hot customer starving others, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
